title: Cylindrical temporal-pattern visualization
summary: dev2 adapts ML dev10 cylindrical temporal hashes directly into CYLINDER_X, CYLINDER_Y and explicit TIME graph axes.
invariants: The adapter consumes MLTemporalPatternHash published points rather than recomputing angle, radius or height.
Each graph series retains the originating temporal hash.
Each graph point retains the originating MLCylindricalTemporalPoint.
Time is an explicit coordinate and is never inferred from array order.
